record.title: Charlevoix Common Vision for the Future of Artificial Intelligence
record.short_title: G7 Charlevoix Common Vision on AI
record.issuing_body: G7 Leaders (Canadian G7 Presidency), Charlevoix Summit
record.summary: Statement in which the G7 leaders commit to promote human-centric AI and its commercial adoption. The twelve commitments cover safeguarding privacy and cybersecurity, research and development on safety, assurance and data quality, addressing accountability, liability, security, safety and bias, initiatives that promote safety and transparency with guidance on human intervention in AI decisions, multistakeholder dialogue, voluntary codes of conduct, and AI-related education, skills and gender equality.
record.notes: One of eight declarations issued by the G7 leaders at the Charlevoix summit in Quebec. Published by Global Affairs Canada, as the presidency, in English and French.
